changeLog.change: Removed unique constraint on places.title. Previously title had a global unique index, which incorrectly prevented different users from creating places with the same title and was the likely root cause of a POST /places 500/duplicate-key bug. A per-owner compound unique index ({owner, title}) was considered but rejected — decided titles don't need to be unique at all, even for the same user. The old single-field unique index (title_1) was dropped via a one-off migration script (server/scripts/drop-title-index.js). No replacement index was created.
